# Genuine source excerpt

`ncsi_2025_10_activity_excerpt.txt` contains six actual rows from [NCSI Monthly Statistical Bulletin, October 2025](https://api.ncsi.gov.om/uploads/pdfs/publicationpdf1761108337.pdf), printed page 33, table 29. Values and column ordering were inspected through the web tool on 2026-10-12. Six columns are: annual 2024; July, August and September 2025; January–September 2024 and 2025. The last column is percentage change.

This is a test transcription, not a downloaded original, full dataset, or evidence that Poppler extraction has been validated. Arabic parentheses/spacing and English label order were normalized for parsing tests; numeric values are unchanged. Original byte checksums are unavailable until download succeeds.
